display.purpose: Hero headlines only. Clamp-based fluid sizing. Tight tracking and near-1.0 line-height create mass.

headline.purpose: Page and section headings, featured event titles.

title.purpose: Card headings, sub-page titles, dialog headings.

body.purpose: All prose content. Max 65–75ch line length.

label.purpose: Category markers, eyebrow text, nav tabs. Always uppercase with wide tracking.

mono.purpose: Ticket counts, event totals, date/time, leaderboard numbers.

shadows.name: card-resting
shadows.purpose: Event cards at rest. Nearly invisible — separates white card from cream canvas without hard contrast.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Event cards on hover, paired with translateY(-1px). Signals interactivity.

shadows.name: ambient-sm
shadows.purpose: Chips, small action buttons, minor floating elements at rest.

shadows.name: cta-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary CTAs on hover. Terra-tinted glow reinforces the brand color in the elevation layer.

shadows.name: dialog-float
shadows.purpose: Floating panels (calendar picker, tooltips). Never on inline content.

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: Card entrances. Slight overshoot gives cards physical weight. Use only on transform, never on layout properties.

motion.name: expo-reveal
motion.purpose: Hero text reveal, large section entrances.

motion.name: standard-ease
motion.purpose: Hover state transitions (background, border, shadow). Fast and responsive.

motion.name: scroll-driven
motion.purpose: Scroll-reveal on event cards. CSS-native, GPU-accelerated. Graceful fallback for unsupported browsers.

motion.name: heartbeat
motion.purpose: Footer heartbeat mark (lub-DUB double-beat pattern). Use only on the ♥ motif.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.note: Desktop nav appears; bottom nav hidden. Primary layout breakpoint.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.note: Full 3-col card grids; additional nav items (Tonight, Weekend) appear.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.note: Minimal layout changes; mainly used for form layouts.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Terra pill — the system's primary call to action. Rarity is the point; don't overuse.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 20px; background: #9a442d; color: #fbf7f1; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease-out, box-shadow 0.2s ease-out, transform 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7d3725; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(154,68,45,0.20); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #006a62; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.7; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Outline pill for secondary actions. Adobe border at rest; terra on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 16px; background: transparent; color: #4a3f3a; border: 1px solid #ddc9a3; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease-out, border-color 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #9a442d; border-color: #9a442d; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #006a62; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Mood and category filter chips. Terra tint unselected; terra fill selected.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-shrink: 0; padding: 8px 14px; background: rgba(154,68,45,0.10); color: #9a442d; border: 1px solid rgba(154,68,45,0.20); border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.15s ease-out, color 0.15s ease-out, border-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #9a442d; color: #fbf7f1; border-color: #9a442d; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #006a62; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Event Card
components.description: The primary list component. White card on cream canvas. Spring entrance on load; lifts on hover.
components.html:
Music

Sunshine Theater · Nob Hill

Calexico & Iron & Wine

Fri May 9 · 8:00 PM · From $35
components.css: .ds-event-card { position: relative; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(240,228,204,0.80); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(26,22,20,0.04); transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease-out, transform 0.3s ease-out; } .ds-event-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(26,22,20,0.12); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-event-card__image { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16/10; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0e4cc 0%, #ddc9a3 100%); } .ds-event-card__image img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; } .ds-event-card__category { position: absolute; top: 6px; left: 6px; background: rgba(154,68,45,0.90); color: #fbf7f1; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; backdrop-filter: blur(4px); } .ds-event-card__body { padding: 10px 12px; } .ds-event-card__venue { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #9a442d; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0 0 3px; } .ds-event-card__title { font-family: Epilogue, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; color: #1a1614; letter-spacing: -0.2px; line-height: 1.25; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-event-card__meta { font-family: Space Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #4a3f3a; margin: 0; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Full-width search field with left icon and clear button. Terra border on focus.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-search__icon { position: absolute; left: 12px; color: #8a7a74; pointer-events: none; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-search__input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 36px 10px 38px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e8ddd0; border-radius: 12px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #1a1614; transition: border-color 0.15s ease-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-search__input::placeholder { color: #b0a69e; } .ds-search__input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #9a442d; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(154,68,45,0.12); }

components.name: Desktop Nav
components.description: Sticky top nav with logo and pill-style links. Active: terra fill. Backdrop blur over content.
components.html:
ABQ Unplugged
DiscoverEventsTonight
components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 40; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 0 24px; height: 56px; background: rgba(251,247,241,0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid #f0e4cc; } .ds-nav__logo { font-family: Epilogue, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 900; color: #1a1614; text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: -0.3px; } .ds-nav__links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; } .ds-nav__link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #4a3f3a; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s ease-out, color 0.15s ease-out; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nav__link:hover { background: #f0e4cc; color: #1a1614; } .ds-nav__link--active { background: #9a442d; color: #fbf7f1; } .ds-nav__link--active:hover { background: #7d3725; }

components.name: Category Badge
components.description: Small absolute-positioned pill on event card images. Comes in terra, sage, and turquoise variants.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; backdrop-filter: blur(4px); } .ds-badge--terra { background: rgba(154,68,45,0.90); color: #fbf7f1; } .ds-badge--sage { background: rgba(79,98,73,0.90); color: #fbf7f1; } .ds-badge--turquoise { background: rgba(0,106,98,0.90); color: #fbf7f1; } .ds-badge--free { background: rgba(79,98,73,0.90); color: #fbf7f1; }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Small uppercase label in terra — used above section headings, on venue names in cards.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #9a442d; letter-spacing: 0.20em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0 0 6px; }

narrative.overview:
ABQ Unplugged is a city's printed bulletin board, digitized with intention. The aesthetic owes more to a well-made alternative weekly than a tech product: warm cream paper stock, terra-cotta ink that feels sun-baked and local, headings that assert themselves without shouting. The tone is a Burqueño who has been to the show — confident, slightly playful, never corporate.

The system is light-mode only, and that choice is load-bearing. A warm cream base (#fbf7f1) with ink (#1a1614) text reads like a page held in golden-hour light. The city this site serves runs on sunlight, adobe, and big sky.

Density is deliberately moderate: not sparse like a marketing landing page, not crammed like a ticketing dashboard. The grid breathes; sections have rhythm.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream-and-terra palette rooted in New Mexico materials
Three-weight typography hierarchy (Epilogue headings, Inter body, Space Grotesk data)
Mostly flat elevation, with lift reserved for interactive states
Pill-heavy component shapes — soft, readable, not sharp-edged
Spring-physics card entrances; scroll-driven reveals; no gratuitous motion
Voice: the insider, not the algorithm

rules.name: The Terra Economy Rule
rules.body: Terra (#9a442d) appears on ≤15% of any given screen at rest. It is the brand's voice, not wallpaper. When everything is terra, nothing is.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Black Rule
rules.body: #000000 and #ffffff are forbidden. Every neutral is tinted toward the brand hue.

rules.name: The No-Muted-On-Small-Text Rule
rules.body: #8a7a74 (ink-muted) fails WCAG AA at small sizes. Use it only on labels 14px or larger.

rules.name: The Weight Contrast Rule
rules.body: Epilogue 900 next to Inter 400 creates the system's core tension. Never mix Epilogue 700/800 with Inter 500/600 — the contrast collapses.

rules.name: The Negative-Tracking Rule
rules.body: Epilogue at display size gets -1.5px tracking. At headline size, -0.4 to -0.5px. Never apply positive tracking to Epilogue.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, lift, focus) or structural depth (floating dialogs). Decorative shadows are prohibited.

dos: Do use #9a442d terra as the primary accent — on buttons, active states, headlines over cream, and category chips. Its rarity is the point; protect it.
Do use Epilogue 900 for all headings. Never Epilogue 400–600.
Do keep card borders warm (#f0e4cc or #ddc9a3) — cold grey borders read as a different product.
Do animate card entrances with spring physics (cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), 0.5s).
Do use scroll-driven CSS animations (animation-timeline: view()) with graceful fallback.
Do label category context with the terra eyebrow label style: Inter 600, 11px, UPPERCASE, 0.20em tracking.
Do use #006a62 turquoise for the global focus ring.
Do use Space Grotesk for all numeric data: event counts, ticket prices, times.
Do write copy in the Burqueño voice: 'Tonight', 'Worth knowing', 'If you only do one thing'.
donts: Don't use pure black #000000 or pure white #ffffff on the main canvas.
Don't use #8a7a74 (ink-muted) for body copy or interactive labels at small sizes — WCAG AA fail.
Don't use saturated blues, purples, or hot pinks — off-brand.
Don't add left-stripe borders (border-left > 1px as a colored accent) to cards, alerts, or list items.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Headlines are solid-color.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. Glass surfaces are limited to sticky nav, bottom nav, and absolute image badges.
Don't claim 'the only' or 'the best'. The brand is 'the easiest way' or 'all in one place'.
Don't add motion to layout properties (width, height, top, left). Animate only transform and opacity.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing — expo ease-out or spring curve only.
Don't render identical card grids — mix card sizes, use horizontal scroll rows, vary the rhythm.
Don't over-emoji. One per social caption; zero in UI elements except Mood Chips.
